findings.title: Fall back when the clicked line has no interaction carets
findings.message: InteractionLayout includes line bounds even for unsupported vertical/math lines that have no carets. In a layout containing both supported and unsupported lines, clicking an unsupported line selects that line by vertical distance, but this loop finds no matching caret and returns the first caret from another line with success. TextField.pixelToCursor consequently skips its legacy hit-testing fallback and places the cursor on the wrong line.
findings.suggestion: Return false when no caret was found on the selected line so pixelToCursor can use legacy hit-testing. Add a regression test with a horizontal line followed by an unsupported vertical/math line.
